note_en: The 把 construction moves the object in front of the verb, and the verb then needs a result attached: 把音量调小一点 "turn the volume down a bit" (调 adjust + 小 small), 把音响关掉 "switch the sound system off" (关 shut + 掉 away). English can say "turn it down" or "switch it off" with particles; Chinese uses a result complement in the same slot, and a bare verb after 把 usually sounds unfinished.
